Positive Sum Pepes

Base Sepolia testnet · chain 84532

This page records the deployment. Open the accompanying PSP app to play.

Factory: 0xc5ddf67eEf7c8Aa2f01043BbE72BE5cb0dbd41C4

  • Minimum purchase and predeposit: 0.005 mixETH.
  • Each whole 0.005 mixETH purchase unit earns a ladder seat and adds up to 4 minutes 20 seconds.
  • The latest ten seats share the pot when the clock expires. Selling keeps your seats.
  • Earned staking fees survive withdrawal. Dead-round backing remains redeemable without a deadline.

Test tokens have no monetary value. This release is for testing and has not completed a human security audit.
